note: Tier audit (Bossing A). MODEL — seven lines, each pinned in scripts/tests/units/jill.test.ts against its nearest-wrong counterfactual: J1 S1 Magnum Ammo Normal Attack Damage ▲30% (normalAttackPct, normal-scoped passive); J2 S1 burst-cast True Damage ▲34.99%/10s; J3 S2 Acid Ammo 192%/s sustained dot; J4 S2 full-burst-entry ATK ▲40.03%/10s; J5 burst Attack Damage ▲75%/10s; J6 burst Hit Rate ▲80.78%/10s; J7 burst 'Removes 100% of ammo. Forced Reload.' as consumeAmmo fraction 1 on the burstCast block. ACID AMMO: the kit's 'upon reloading to max, the first round deals sustained damage 192%/s for 30 sec' re-applies on every reload (~5s cadence), so it is effectively permanent and ships as ONE permanent dot (durationSec 99999) rather than a one-shot 30s window. It takes the +50% FB major by landing timing (only modernia's Paradise Lost is type-exempt) and is range-exempt (noRange, universal for riders). CADENCE (MEASURED 2026-07-13, test battery 2 test 4, jill focus video): her datamined rate_of_fire is 150 rpm = 2.5 shots/sec (magnum), NOT the assault-rifle class default ~740 rpm — the video's ammo counter drops one round per ~0.4-0.5s. charFixes.pullsPerSec 2.5. Her per-hit popup values match the sim at 99.7% across all four classes (body 180,633 / core hit 319,582 / crit 250,107 / acid tick 288,662). RELOAD: she pays her normal synced reload (reloadFrames 81 -> 92f effective; no charFixes reload override) — a single-chunk reloader (datamine reload_bullet 10000) with no rolling or partial-reload mechanic. The burst's 'Reload speed is fixed at a 99.96% increase for 10 sec' is a stat LOCK (owner ruling 2026-07-22: 'is fixed at' clamps the stat at that level — it does NOT grant +99.96% speed) → reloadSpeedClamp 99.96/10s, which overrides additive reloadSpeedPct buffs while active. J7's forced reload adds only the COST: the kit PURPOSE of that reload — re-triggering Magnum Ammo and Acid Ammo, both keyed on 'upon reloading to Max Ammunition' — is already carried by modeling those two as permanent, so the benefit is not double-counted. TRUE NORMALS: 'Normal attacks deal True Damage for 10 sec' is a same-weapon flavor swap — weaponSwap damagePct 71.09 (her exact datamined normalMult, damage-neutral apart from flavor) trueNormals + sameWeapon durationSec 10 on burstCast (the chisato primitive; sameWeapon is what withholds the magazine refill at both ends — trueNormals is only the damage flavor) — converting ~25 normals/burst to true flavor and co-activating J2 in the window. The engine's swap fire-cadence branch falls back to her measured `charFixes.pullsPerSec` (2.5) for this same-weapon swap (`u.swap.weapon` undefined) before the AR weapon-class default, so her magnum keeps its measured 150 rpm cadence for the 10s window instead of the class default 12/s. She is the roster's only unit carrying both a `charFixes.pullsPerSec` and a `weaponSwap`, so the fallback is behavior-identical for every other carrier. Board mean 0.983 (0.92 / 1.00 / 1.03). Her sameWeapon flavor swap does not free-refill ammo on exit, so her reload-cycle phase at the moment the swap+FB gauge-lock lifts is real state that persists — this is the source of a small (<3% single-run, ~0.3% MC-mean), FB-count-preserving cast-timing ripple on other B3-alternating units sharing a chain with her in the misc-B3s comp (see DECISIONS.md 2026-08-10). OPEN: confirm her acid tick jumps x1.5 inside FB from the battery-2-test-4 focus video (the 288,662 read was ambiguous on FB-state); do NOT re-fudge.
